rationale: Same pin (AI Factory 1.0.2 at ba64c62), no upstream change. Mapped files changed in 1.5.0: host-execution.md documents the loop's resume of a REPORTED task at the gate and its refusals, and PROVENANCE.md adds the 1.5.0 section and the orchestrate 0.8.0 row. The factory-derived rules are unchanged: the finding decision catalogue, bounded rework and support rounds, non-convergence blocking and gate triage still apply, since a resumed task reruns its gates and review and any rework goes through the same engine budget.
reviewer: Independent read-only reviewer agent (did not write the change) on October 4, 2026, reviewing the uncommitted 1.5.0 diff: PASS, no blocking defects. It confirmed the gitlink at e4d73a7 (git describe v0.8.0) and cmp exit 0 for the shipped loop; that resume_reported only reads (run_state, blocker, run_engine.load, snapshot, evidence_current, _unoverridden_failures; no transaction or harvest); that the resumed path keeps the engine invariants (gate and review-token accept REPORTED in unintegrated IMPLEMENTING; task-rework accepts REPORTED; the earlier implementer stays excluded as a reviewer; harvested and late FAILs fail closed; stale_report is checked up front and again at review import); that every task status is handled (PREPARED/REWORK prepared, missing/INVALIDATED via task-prepare, REPORTED resumed after checks, DISPATCHED and VERIFIED refused with their way out); and that RunError/GitError are caught in the function while KeyError/OSError/ValueError reach main's JSON error object. Notes, not defects: test_a_verified_task_is_refused also passes on the old code (a guard only); SubmoduleCleanupTests cover the 1.4.1 fix and add no code; a REPORTED task in a non-IMPLEMENTING or integrated run and a real harvested FAIL blocking a resume are refused by code but not tested end to end; the upstream loop gives resumed reviewers no report text. Review prose does not authenticate identity. Follow-up on October 4, 2026, after the coordinator's independent review of release/1.5.0 (PASS, no defects) asked to close its coverage gaps: resume_reported now also runs the engine's harvest_reviews on a deep copy of the loaded run, so a FAIL verdict already returned to the host journal but not yet harvested refuses the resume up front; the run itself is still not written. New tests cover the refusal branches end to end. The same independent reviewer re-reviewed this follow-up on October 4, 2026: FAIL with one minor defect (an unreadable journal let prepare resume; the engine still refused later at review-close with harvest_incomplete), which the second follow-up fixes. Second follow-up on October 4, 2026: the coordinator's re-review of the uncommitted follow-up returned FAIL with one minor defect (harvest_reviews never raises, so an unreadable journal left the copy's harvest incomplete and prepare still returned resume_at gate; reproduced with chmod 000 on journal.jsonl). resume_reported now calls run_engine.require_complete_harvest on the harvested copy and refuses with harvest_incomplete, its reason and the unreadable paths. Re-reviewed on October 4, 2026 by the same independent reviewer: PASS, no defects; a chmod-000 journal probe now refuses with no file written under the run store or host root, the new test fails with the fix removed, docs and lock hashes verified, tests.test_workflows 30 OK. A live two-session run of the exported 1.5.0 package (host session terminated during a 700 s gate, gate-recover, shipped loop relaunched) resumed the REPORTED task at the gate without a new dispatch and reached COMPLETE.
